name: diya-submit
title: DIY Accounting Submit
description: Open a saved DIYA book, derive the nine boxes of a UK VAT return and read stored VAT receipts. A person checks and files in the browser.

authentication.tokenBinding: A bearer token is accepted only when it is a Cognito access token from this server's issuer and its client_id is the app client that only this server uses. A Cognito access token carries no aud claim, so the audience is not checked.
